notes: The 1988 volume of the Recreation and Park Commission. Curated: namings, dedications, master plans (Academy of Sciences, Kezar) and the Sixth and Folsom contract.

coverage.remaining: Routine items not curated. Not placed: McLaren Park community garden at 590 Leland Avenue (May 5), Candlestick Park sound system ($1,018,198, Pro Media), Portsmouth Square restroom and elevator structure (Gordon Chang), a plaque at Chinese Playground, the zoo's EIR resolutions.

findings.address_as_written: Naming baseball diamond in memory of Bud DeMeyer
findings.description: At the request of the San Francisco Old Timers Baseball Association, backed by local merchants and neighbors, the Recreation and Park Commission named the baseball diamond at Excelsior Playground in memory of Bud DeMeyer.
